firm_data.firm_description: Turley Redmond & Rosasco, L.L.P., has over 30 years’ experience representing injured and disabled workers in NYC and Long Island. Workers’ compensation, Social Security Disability and construction accident law are all we do!
notable_facts: The firm has recovered over $250,000,000 for their clients in the past 29 years.
The firm offers free case evaluations and a free “second opinion” service for those who already have legal representation.
The firm has six convenient offices across New York City, Suffolk County and Nassau County.

email.subject: AI for Turley Redmond & Rosasco, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Craig,

Recovering over $250,000,000 for clients across workers' compensation, Social Security Disability, and construction accident law takes precision and trust. I'd imagine managing that volume with a 5-attorney team means every workflow decision matters.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to show how our AI handles document review, case assessment, and intake so your team stays focused on strategy and clients.

Worth 20 minutes to explore whether this could work for Turley Redmond & Rosasco?

Vasu
